items: A new animal for a later island: the stegosaurus of the Cinder slopes, black basalt glowing with lava in its cracks, cycads, tree ferns and stunted pines
Its plates stand bold and orange along its back and its tail ends in four great spikes; asleep, its plates rise out of the ash like a ridge of old stones
Its island shows black and volcanic on the sea chart, its lakes lava
